title: Design System: Kirtiraj Chaudhari — X-Ray Hero

display.purpose: H1 in both layers; identical box by construction.

components.name: Professional CTA
components.description: The single hero action in the professional layer.

components.name: Artistic Ghost CTA
components.description: Inert twin that holds the slot open under the lens. Not pressable.

narrative.overview: The hero is the author's own thesis turned on himself: models that show their reasoning, run on the person who built them. A cold professional layer states what he builds. A warm darkroom layer, uncovered by a lens, states why.
keyCharacteristics: Two layers from one template; every geometry value declared once on .hero.
One accent per layer: signal (cold) and safelight (hot).
A single display face and weight in both layers.
Flat surfaces. No card shadows, no glows.
The lens is theatre, not navigation.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Each layer has one accent and no second.

rules.name: The Feather Rule
rules.body: No artistic type may live permanently in the 40%-alpha feather band.

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Both layers share the display face, weight and tracking.

rules.name: The Per-Frame Rule
rules.body: Only transform, opacity and mask-feeding attributes change per frame.

dos: Do declare every geometry value once on .hero and consume it in both layers.
Do keep every link, heading, and case study reachable in accessible DOM.
Do hold 4.5:1 for all text in both layers.
donts: Don't invent poetry, lyrics, captions, or photo credits.
Don't add a second CTA, a second accent, or a gradient blob.
Don't use live filters or full-bleed raster imagery in the masked layer.
